title: RootSignatureProduction
description: A single custodian signature produced OFFLINE during the BANZA offline root-key ceremony. Public material only: the root key id, the custodian, a detached ed25519 signature (base64url), the hash that was signed, and the algorithm. A valid root action requires at least 2 of 3 such signatures (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_THRESHOLD if fewer). NO private key, seed or passphrase appears here — a signature is public data. The signed_hash covers root metadata, a delegation, a rotation, a revocation or the trust policy only — never a payment, an operator authorisation, a licence or a fund movement. Status is computed by applying the rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

key_id.description: Root key id that produced this signature (e.g. 'root-key-A').

custodian.description: Custodian who signed OFFLINE with their single root private key.

signature.description: Detached signature over signed_hash (base64url, ed25519). Public material only.

signed_hash.description: The content hash that was signed. Covers a root-scope object only (root_metadata, delegation, rotation, revocation, trust_policy).

value.description: Digest over the canonical signed bytes.
